Comprehension Question: Do you think spinning on the chair likely just made you dizzy?

Title: Pain in Side
Scenario: While walking to school, you get a sharp, stabbing pain in your lower right side. You instantly wonder if your appendix just burst. The pain eases after a few blocks, so you figure it was probably just a cramp.
Comprehension Question: Do you believe the sharp pain in your side means your appendix burst?

Title: Dizzy at Lunch
Scenario: The bell rings to signal the end of lunch. You stand up from the table and feel a rush of dizziness, causing you to immediatley sit back down. As you recover, you think that your spinning head is a signal of dehydration.
Comprehension Question: Do you think your dizziness signals dehydration rather than something dangerous?

Title: Walking to School
Scenario: It's a freezing cold day outside and you shiver in your coat on your walk to school. When you arrive, you notice the tips of your fingers are red and tingling, and you feel a shock of fear, thinking of frostbite. You think your fingers will probably be fine.
Comprehension Question: Do you think your fingers will probably be fine?

Title: Reading a Book
Scenario: It is a beautiful spring day, and you are sitting on a bench at the park reading a book. A person walking their dog in front of you suddently starts to sneeze loudy and doesn't cover their face. You suddenly worry that you're sitting too close and might catch something dangerous. As you think this, you notice the pollen in the air, and realize the dog-walked is probably just allergic.
Comprehension Question: Do you realize the dog walker is probably just allergic rather than contagious?

Title: Doctor's Orders 2
Scenario: At your routine doctor's appointment, your doctor decides to run a few tests to evaluate your health. Your results will be ready within a week. While waiting for your results, you think you are likely healthy.
Comprehension Question: Do you assume the worst about your test results while waiting?

Title: Racing Heart
Scenario: As you're walking to your first period class, your heart begins racing in your class. You sit down at your desk and you start to wonder if you’re having a heart attack. As you feel your heart beat quickly, you remember you had coffee this morning and barely slept, so you are probably just jittery.
Comprehension Question: Do you think you're probably just jittery from caffeine and lack of sleep?

Title: Sitting Up Quickly 2
Scenario: As you wake up in the morning, you sit up quickly. Your vision goes blurry, and then goes black for a moment. Your vision comes back after a moment, and you tell yourself that it happened because you sat up quickly.
Comprehension Question: Do you realize your vision went dark because you stood up too quickly?

Title: Pinky Finger Ache
Scenario: After scrolling on your phone for a while, your pinky finger goes numb and tingly. You worry it’s a sign of a neurological issue. You shake your hand out and feeling returns, so you think your pinky probably just got pins and needles.
Comprehension Question: Do you worry your numb finger signals a serious neurological issue, even after the feeling returns?
